life.label: Policy received
life.detail: Day 0 is the day your policy document reaches you. This app counts the free-look days from here.

life.label: Free-look ends
life.detail: The page says free look is available for all life insurance policies. Return the policy before this day.

sources.evidence: available for all Life Insurance policies

life.label: Claim intimation
life.day_text: No day count on the page
life.detail: The page says claims have been rejected on technical grounds like slight delays in intimation, and that IRDAI has advised insurers on this. Read the page for the exact advice, and check your policy for its own period.

life.label: Insurer reply
life.day_text: No day count on the pages yet
life.detail: Before any escalation, the Ombudsman page requires that you have first approached your insurer with the complaint.

sources.evidence: first approached your insurance company with the complaint

life.label: Escalate: Bima Bharosa / Ombudsman
life.detail: Bima Bharosa is IRDAI's grievance portal (launched 2022). The Ombudsman passes an award within 3 months of receiving all the requirements from you.

sources.evidence: within 3 months of receiving all the requirements
